question: Which of the following states has a sparse population mainly due to hilly terrain?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** is one of the northeastern states of India with a **sparse population**.
 
• The state is primarily characterized by its **hilly terrain and dense forests**, which make habitation and agricultural activities challenging.
 
• It is located in the **Himalayan region**, contributing to its rugged topography.
